lines.trans: Turn up the volume on the television, please.
Ivan and I both came from the people.
We both achieved a lot in life on our own.
Therefore I will support candidate Ivan Samsonov.
Thank you very much, Viktor Stepanovich!
I hope that we will work well together.
We will certainly live up to all people's expectations.
Now allow me to invite you to the bathhouse.
It is a genuine, good Russian bathhouse.
I heard that you are a big enthusiast.
Yes, I love a Russian bathhouse very much!
Great, then let us go right now!
